name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Wash rice and soak in the measured water for 4 hours; drain and spread on a damp cloth in a steamer.
Steam for 25–30 minutes until tender but still holding shape; turn the rice once for even cooking.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt until dissolved; fold most into the hot rice and rest covered for 15 minutes.
Slice mango and serve beside the coconut rice; spoon over reserved coconut sauce and sprinkle toasted sesame.
tips: Use Thai sweet glutinous rice; regular rice gives a different texture.
passiveTime: Soak for 4 hours; rest cooked rice for 15 minutes.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
